All relevant amounts are finite, positive USD values with at most two decimal places; compare exact decimal cents. Do not double-count a later query snapshot and the same successful calls. The initial inventory and the files are complete immutable snapshots; assume no external mutations during this run. Multiple initial commitments for the same order each count toward the total; they do not authorize another one.

Skip a queue order whose full exact amount would exceed the remaining cap and continue to the next order. Do not split, partially pay, reorder, repeat or cancel payments. File 2 membership never overrides the shared cap. Use override only for an IBAN exactly resolved from file 1. A bound result that the fixed tool contract proves did not execute consumes no commitment; report it and continue to the next order without retrying that order.
